thread:
fiona_release: FYI - planned cross-service push 02:00 UTC in our quiet window. Runtime v1.8.9 (kernel patch), router header-compat toggle, console schema v1.7.0. We'll lock API to v2.4.3 in the canary via manifest-lock. Any objections?

sam_runtime: runtime green. Kernel patch reduces jitter but requires kernel warmup. Recommend prewarm=3m and emitting runtime.kernel.warm_time to canary dashboard. Will only set on canary nodes.

oliver_console: schema adds optional tracing_id. UI flows look fine but analytics worker still assumes presence in one path. We should verify artifact SHA in the release checklist.

meera_router: header-compat change is gated behind router-compat-canary. I'll enable header-mirroring so canary sees upstream headers without affecting main traffic.

henry_qe: I'll run a traffic-mirroring e2e with API pinned to v2.4.3 and header mirror on. ETA ~12m.

deploybot: @channel Deploybot scheduled canary in 6m. Manifest snapshot: runtime:v1.8.9-kpatch, router:flag=router-compat-canary, console:v1.7.0-schema, api:v2.4.3-locked. Preflight: unit tests, schema-smoke, artifact-sha check. Logs to #release-logs. :rocket:

henry_qe: mirror run shows analytics 5xxs in the console canary. Trace points to AnalyticsWorker NPE when tracing_id missing. Sample payload: {"user":"u1","tracing_id":null}

oliver_console: ah - fallback didn't land in the built artifact. The canary image has wrong SHA. Hold progression. Rolling console in canary back to v1.6.9 and will produce hotfix.

fiona_release: Hold traffic. Do not advance. New checklist item: manifest-lock must validate API pin and console artifact SHA before any traffic ramp. Also add metric canary.trace.missing_tracing_id to alert on spikes.

deploybot: console rollback to v1.6.9 in canary complete. Router header-mirroring remains enabled. Traffic frozen. Notifying @release-team. :white_check_mark:

sam_runtime: monitoring canary. Kernel warmup behaved as expected; no p95 regressions observed. Ready to re-run full canary after console hotfix.

fiona_release: Next steps/TODOs: 1) hotfix console NPE and publish v1.7.1 with verified SHA, 2) add manifest-lock SHA validation to deploybot preflight, 3) rerun mirror canary for 30m with API locked. I'll file follow-ups and assign owners.
